name: staleness-against-seen
means: A confirmed relation keeps seen, the fingerprints of both anchors its confirmer saw; it is stale when an anchor it propagates from (by its predicate: dst->src, src->dst, both or none) now fingerprints differently, and broken when an anchor is gone; judged against seen rather than a machine's baseline, the verdict on a relation carrying seen is the same on every machine and across a merge. A seen written in an older fingerprint format is not stale while the anchor's current bytes still produce it in that format, so such a relation cannot see a change in what its anchor reads until a reconfirm upgrades it; a relation from before seen existed is judged against this machine's baseline, or reported unjudged.
